item.tiered.rune_steel.lore: Tempers the steel toward rare quality.
item.tiered.rune_frost.lore: Hardens flesh and gear against the long winter.
item.tiered.rune_shadow.lore: Etches the dark's swift gifts into your gear.
item.tiered.rune_obsidian.lore: Obsidian gives and obsidian takes — it may pry an imprint loose, or carve a fresh rune slot.
item.tiered.rune_amber.lore: Old light that favors the rarest forging.
item.tiered.rune_crimson.lore: Brands a weapon's edge with lasting fury.
item.tiered.rune_sandstone.lore: Coarse work; never better than uncommon.
effect.tiered.mend.desc: Restores a percentage of the item's max durability.
effect.tiered.extract.desc: Pulls one imprint slot off the item onto this rune.
effect.tiered.forget.desc: Wipes all imprints and the item's tier.
effect.tiered.stabilize.desc: Can't roll lower than your current rarity tier.
effect.tiered.overcharge.desc: Consumes extra base materials. Guarantees rare+ and strongly boosts rarity — more cost, more power.
effect.tiered.grant_rune_slot.desc: Adds a rune slot to a weapon or armor and is consumed — it never takes up a slot itself.

screen.tiered.reforge.material.groups.de: Restricts results to these rarity groups.

screen.tiered.reforge.material.rarity_bo: Pushes the roll toward higher rarities.
screen.tiered.reforge.material.preserves: Won't reroll your modifier — effects and imprints still apply.
screen.tiered.reforge.material.no_base_i: Doesn't need a repair material in slot 0 — tier still rerolls.
screen.tiered.reforge.material.standalon: No base material needed and won't reroll your tier.

screen.tiered.reforge.material.effect.ov: Consumes extra base materials. Guarantees rare+ and strongly boosts rarity — more cost, more power.
screen.tiered.reforge.material.effect_po: Rolls a random effect from a pool when this rune is generated.
screen.tiered.reforge.material.behavior_: Rolls a random reforge bias (group filter, rarity boost, etc.) when this rune is generated.
screen.tiered.reforge.material.effect_po: Rolls one of several effect sets when this rune is generated — which set you get is random.
screen.tiered.reforge.material.behavior_: Rolls one of several reforge-bias sets when this rune is generated — which set you get is random.
